stage0045_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Looks like the event's a hit.」

stage0045_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$クレア$$
「Mr. $$ドナール$$,
　why not enjoy the movie with
　someone too?」

stage0045_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ドナール$$
「Unfortunately,
　since one of my wings was torn off back then.」

stage0045_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$学園長$$
「Chairwoman!
　A dimensional boundary warp confirmed over the ocean!」

stage0045_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$クレア$$
「Don't tell me, a dimensional gate...!」

stage0045_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I can feel it...! I feel her scent...!
　Where is she!?」

stage0045_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アマタ$$
「From '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$'...!」

stage0045_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hand civilian evacuation to $$２１世紀警備保障$$,
　launch everyone who's already back.」

stage0045_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So you finally showed up, Mechanical Angel!
　I'll finish you off quick,
　and get my hands on $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0045_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That guy...!
　Is he talking about $$ミコノ$$!?」

stage0045_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Seems like $$ユノハ$$ wasn't around before launch...」

stage0045_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Probably babysitting $$ジン$$.
　That guy... acting selfish for just a cadet...」

stage0045_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$学園長$$
「High aura levels detected on the enemy commander!」

stage0045_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$クレア$$
「Are you saying the Abductor's pilot
　is an Element!?」

stage0045_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$不動$$
「When love turns to hatred, all flame is
　sealed in ice, and light becomes darkness...!」

stage0045_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$不動$$
「Reason doesn't work on it!
　The trapper becomes the trapped!」

stage0045_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$桂$$
「Dunno what it all means,
　but that guy's trouble!」

stage0045_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カレン$$
「You'll pay for ruining a perfectly good event!」

stage0045_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, deploy!
　Take down the enemy commander fast,
　and drive them back!」

stage0045_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Let's go, Ayanami.
　There's still plenty of people at the academy.」

stage0045_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Daddy's Boy!
　If you hold me back, you won't hear the end of it!」

stage0045_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You're the one who formed up without asking...」

stage0045_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アスカ$$
「This is just me paying back the popcorn debt!」

stage0045_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$シンジ$$
（People came to the academy for the movie,
　and $$ジン$$'s there too. I have to do something...）

stage0045_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$ジン$$...!
　We need to head to the command room to prepare, too...」

stage0045_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$...
　You're coming with me」

stage0045_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Stuff like that don't work on me!」

stage0045_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, we take down the enemy commander!
　All units, focus your attacks on it!」

stage0045_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Stuff like that don't work on me!」

stage0045_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ドナール$$
「What's going on!?
　That thing's body... regenerated in an instant!」

stage0045_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$スオミ$$
「We detected a dimensional boundary warp at that moment!」

stage0045_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$クレア$$
「Power for regeneration is being fed in
　from the dimensional gate...?」

stage0045_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right.
　Someone is feeding it high-density energy
　through an intangible tube」

stage0045_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I don't get the logic, but this is great!
　So I can do whatever I want, huh!」

stage0045_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you can get your beloved $$シルフィ$$,
　let me give you a present.」

stage0045_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Further dimensional boundary warp confirmed!」

stage0045_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$赤木$$
「This is bad!
　At this rate, the people at the event will...!」

stage0045_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ランカ$$
「But... what if our song doesn't reach the Vajra again...」

stage0045_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Those Vajra...!
　They used the boundary warp to fold in!」

stage0045_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$!
　Don't try anything unnecessary!」

stage0045_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why so angry?
　I only guided your love.」

stage0045_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$カグラ$$
「...Damn it!
　Guess I'll just beat the Mechanical Angel
　and get $$シルフィ$$ quick!」

stage0045_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$n
「An undying enemy plus a swarm of Vajra...!
　How are we supposed to fight this!」

stage0045_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シンジ$$
「At this rate, the people at the academy...!」

stage0045_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$レイ#168$$
「Still as fired up as ever, Major $$オズマ$$」

stage0045_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$!
　Why would you just dive into the battlefield!」

stage0045_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「M-Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$, this is normal for him...」

stage0045_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Still, this time's way too much!
　There's an enemy we've never seen, plus Vajra!」

stage0045_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Those guys ain't enemies, and this ain't a battlefield!
　This is my live stage!」

stage0045_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's Captain $$オズマ$$'s favorite,
　Fire Bomber's $$熱気バサラ$$...」

stage0045_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$n
「Sounds like he's even crazier than the rumors say」

stage0045_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Been a while, Vajra!
　I'll let you hear plenty of my song!」

stage0045_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アルト$$
「Watch out, $$バサラ$$!
　Not even $$シェリル$$'s or $$ランカ$$'s songs
　worked on them!」

stage0045_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Whether it works or not,
　that's got nothing to do with it!!」

stage0045_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$バサラ$$
「I sing when I want, to who I want,
　as much as I want!!」

stage0045_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「...Guess he really is his usual self」

stage0045_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, PLANET DANCE!!
　Fire it up wild!!」

stage0045_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Amazing...! So good!!
　Hearing $$熱気バサラ$$ live really hits harder!!」

stage0045_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「But, my body... it's getting hot...」

stage0045_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$葵$$
「Still as cool as ever, $$バサラ$$!」

stage0045_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$桂$$
「Whether it works on the Vajra or not
　is secondary to him, huh」

stage0045_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Delta 1 to Skull Leader!
　Know your place, $$オズマ$$!!」

stage0045_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$ランカ$$, $$シェリル$$.
　Let us hear your song, too」

stage0045_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$'s song, and yours too,
　aren't weapons made to fight Vajra」

stage0045_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$...
　Let your song reach the people
　who are waiting for it.」

stage0045_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シェリル$$
「The people waiting for our song... huh...」

stage0045_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シェリル$$
「You're right!
　And with everything we've got!!」

stage0045_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$シェリル$$
（The people who were scared just now...）

stage0045_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ランカ$$
（They're smiling because of our song...）

stage0045_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Fire Bomber can't lose either!」

stage0045_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$, $$バサラ$$!
　I'll cover you!
　Fire Bomber, sing!!」

stage0045_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Right!
　Let's blast off with our sound!!」

stage0045_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Dunno what it is, but,
　this is getting fun!」

stage0045_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I like you!
　Keep on singing!!」

stage0045_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That guy and $$熱気バサラ$$... hitting it off?」

stage0045_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Handling the Abductors and Vajra comes first!」

stage0045_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Luckily, the citizens' panic has died down.
　At this point, we'll have to brace for losses
　and see how they respond...!」

stage0045_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, intercept the Abductors and Vajra!
　Attacking the enemy commander is pointless,
　so don't push it till we find a way!」

stage0045_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that beast just runs wild till then!?」

stage0045_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$葵$$
「That's more than I can take...!
　Its owner should put a collar and leash on it!」

stage0045_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Careful, $$アマタ$$!
　That thing's after you and $$ミコノ$$ for sure!」

stage0045_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Wait for me, my $$シルフィ$$!!
　I'm coming to get you right now!!」

stage0045_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'm sorry...
　Back then... I overheard you talking
　to someone...」

stage0045_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ジン$$
「The world we live in... it's called Altair...
　I have to take you there」

stage0045_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No... I can't go...
　Everyone's out there fighting...
　The people who accepted us...!」

stage0045_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ジン$$
「I calculated it all from the start, everything!
　To steal the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$...!」

stage0045_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ジン$$
「A person like that could never be needed!!」

stage0045_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「...$$ジン$$...
　You've gotten so much brighter since
　you first came here... Was that calculated too...?」

stage0045_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Was everything with $$シンジ$$ a lie too...?」

stage0045_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「But I'm sure everyone needed you too, $$ジン$$!
　So everyone thinks they need you too!」

stage0045_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「No, $$ジン$$...
　At least there's one person who
　definitely thinks they need you...」

stage0045_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「You have them too, don't you, $$ジン$$?
　People you need... people precious to you...」

stage0045_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$シンジ$$, all the Elements...
　Everyone at $c...」

stage0045_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「The Vajra are back again!」

stage0045_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ルカ$$
「As long as the dimensional gate exists,
　the enemy will keep regenerating, and
　Vajra will appear through that warp!」

stage0045_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ミサト$$
「At this rate... we'll wear ourselves out...」

stage0045_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ドナール$$
「If we could just close the dimensional gate...!」

stage0045_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Ahh...!
　We can understand each other...!」

stage0045_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「My heart is connecting with $$ジン$$'s...!」

stage0045_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I can trust you, right, $$ジン$$?」

stage0045_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I can't trust you as the spy you were...
　But I can trust your friendship with $$シンジ$$」

stage0045_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ジン$$
「The dimensional gate is... over there!」

stage0045_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$シンジ$$...!
　I'll fight for $$ユノハ$$ and you!」

stage0045_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$不動$$
「An infinite power, connecting past the stars!」

stage0045_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Amazing...!
　A new weapon is being summoned to $$ゲパルト$$!」

stage0045_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キャシー$$
「The dimensional boundary's warp and the
　severed space are colliding, deadlocked!」

stage0045_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What are you planning, $$シンジ$$!?」

stage0045_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll back $$ジン$$'s power to sever
　with Unit-01's A.T. Field!」

stage0045_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I won't know unless I try!」

stage0045_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$カレン$$
「Hang in there, $$シンジ$$!
　I'm betting on you... on you and $$ジン$$!」

stage0045_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$シュレード$$
「This sound...!
　It's shaking lives... shaking dimensions!!」

stage0045_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Again and again, as many times as it takes...」

stage0045_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$不動$$
「And someday...
　it'll rewrite fate, overcome despair...」

stage0045_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'll keep at it till it works, no matter what!
　For $$ユノハ$$ and $$シンジ$$... for everyone!!」

stage0045_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$不動$$
「The power to sever and the A.T. Field...!
　Now, reject the ring of fate!」

stage0045_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Amazing...!
　That's some real soul, you two!!」

stage0045_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'll apologize later for deceiving you...!
　So for now!」

stage0045_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Tell me everything... $$ジン$$.
　I want to really get to know you」

stage0045_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... those gathered, the $$烙印$$-bearers...」

stage0045_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$葵$$
「That thing...! It's looking right at us!?」

stage0045_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I don't know who that thing is...
　But I know this much!」

stage0045_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「To think it'd show itself before us...!」

stage0045_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No need to rush.
　There's still something for you to do」

stage0045_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But you know, $$ジン$$...
　The price of betrayed love runs high...?」

stage0045_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'm fine...!
　I won't be done in by some thought-form!」

stage0045_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Well, this is a surprise, $$ジン$$!
　Didn't think you'd team up with them!」

stage0045_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$カグラ$$...
　No matter what I say, you're not going back.」

stage0045_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You get that much, at least.
　Then you know I show no mercy
　to anyone who turns against me.」

stage0045_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ジン$$
「Thanks, $$アマタ$$...
　But I... what I've learned, I want him too...
　I want $$カグラ$$ to know it!」

stage0045_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, focus fire on the enemy commander!
　The dimensional gate's gone, it can't regenerate now!」

stage0045_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$カグラ$$
「As if I'd lose without that!
　Here I come, Mechanical Angel!」

stage0045_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let you have your way!!」

stage0045_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ミサト$$
「For a moment there, I wasn't sure how it'd go.」

stage0045_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's thanks to $$ジン$$'s hard work too.」

stage0045_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ジン$$
「...I want to see... the sea...」

stage0045_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ジン$$
「...I can't see... anything...
　Is it... because it's night...?」

stage0045_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「There's no point, I already told you!」

stage0045_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Just as I thought, it's regenerating the unit
　using energy fed from the dimensional gate!」

stage0045_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ドナール$$
「It can't be beaten unless we deal with the gate!」

stage0045_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Everyone, focus attacks on targets other than
　the Abductor commander unit!」

stage0045_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But he'll surely come again...
　to get his hands on $$ミコノ$$.」

stage0045_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「We did it, $$バサラ$$!
　Our song reached the Vajra!」

stage0045_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Hold it, you lot!
　My song's not over yet!」

stage0045_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「So what!
　Driving off the Vajra is our job!」

stage0045_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That's not what I'm here for!
　I just want them to hear my song!」

stage0045_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's fine, $$バサラ$$.
　Sing however you like」

stage0045_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's fine, Miss $$ミレーヌ$$.
　A song isn't a weapon of war」

stage0045_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$ should sing what's in his heart.
　That's who $$バサラ$$ is」

stage0045_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Then I'll sing however I like too!
　It feels better that way!」

stage0045_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's right, Miss $$ミレーヌ$$.
　And protecting Fire Bomber
　is my own fight!」

stage0045_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$クラン$$
「But why did $$シェリル$$'s song fail
　while $$バサラ$$'s worked?」

stage0045_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I can't explain it, but maybe
　they were too conscious of
　the Vajra's presence?」

stage0045_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Wanting so badly to affect the Vajra
　may have confused them instead...」

stage0045_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ルカ$$
「As expected, Captain $$ガムリン$$.
　You're $$バサラ$$'s best supporter」

stage0045_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I, I love Fire Bomber with a heart
　as hot as anyone's, you know!」

stage0045_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I know.
　It's everyone's feelings like that
　that fuel $$バサラ$$'s fire」

stage0045_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ルカ$$
（Captain $$ガムリン$$ is so mature）

stage0045_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'll get my hot feelings to $$バサラ$$!
　Radically fire it up!!」

stage0045_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（Meanwhile, our captain turns into this
　the moment Fire Bomber's involved...）

stage0045_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「This guy...!
　He's way stronger than the last time we fought!」

stage0045_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$カグラ$$
「This is my true power!
　Know your place, scentless man!!」

stage0045_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Not a chance!
　I'll protect $$ミコノ$$, no matter what!」

stage0045_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That woman is my $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0045_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Can you hear me, $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0045_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I hate you so much!
　I've hated you since the first time I saw you!
　My $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0045_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So hate me! Kill me!
　Yes, right here in my arms, forever...!」

stage0045_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You bastard!
　Don't you daaare scare $$ミコノ$$!!」

stage0045_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ジン$$! Didn't think I'd really throw down with you!」

stage0045_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ジン$$
「Listen, $$カグラ$$!
　Here on Vega, I found a $$レア・イグラー$$
　that's mine alone!」

stage0045_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ジン$$
「That's not all!
　I found friends and comrades too!」

stage0045_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Good for you!
　But I found something too, my $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0045_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Anyone who stands in my way of
　taking her gets no mercy, whoever they are!
　Even you!」

stage0045_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ジン$$
「Stop it, $$カグラ$$!
　Doing things that way will only hurt
　the heart of someone precious to you!」

stage0045_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ジン$$
「$$ユノハ$$ and $$シンジ$$ taught me!
　The warmth, the joy, the importance
　of understanding someone, of connecting hearts!」

stage0045_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ジン$$
「That's why, $$カグラ$$!
　I want you to know it too!」

stage0045_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Warmth...!?
　That kind of thing isn't needed to survive!」

stage0045_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What matters most to survive is power!
　I learned that on Altair!」

stage0045_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So I fight!
　To kill my $$シルフィ$$ with this power!!」

stage0045_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ジン$$
「You stubborn fool!
　Then I'll stop you myself!」

stage0045_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$! You sing!
　I'll fight my own fight!」

stage0045_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here we go, Vajra!!
　Hear my song!!」

stage0045_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「I'll say this much, I'm a soldier...!
　Just as $$バサラ$$ stakes his life on song,
　I fight with my life on the line!」

stage0045_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's all to protect people!
　Come at me once you're ready to die for it!!」

stage0045_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Alright, you!
　Keep singing! Make my blood burn!」

stage0045_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「You got it, here's a hot number!
　One so hot it makes fighting seem stupid!」

stage0045_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$正太郎$$
（I'm sure everyone... though they won't say it,
　threw this event because they're worried about me...）

stage0045_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$正太郎$$
（I've got to work hard to live up to that too...!
　For peace, and for everyone!）
